text:
sanjay: quick sync — want to propose a small revamp of the model admission pipeline. focus: benchmarks, deterministic validation, and compatibility gates. can we do a 15m?
emma: yes. main thing: add a reproducible microbench step (seq lens 8/128/2048, batch 1/8/32) capturing p50/p90/p99 latency + peak GPU memory. short runs only.
liam: also need a kernel/quantization compatibility matrix. some fp16 -> int8 conversions blow up on older drivers. pipeline should record driver, cuda/cuobjdump hashes.
claire: + tokenizer roundtrip tests. make sure encode(decode(text)) stable for our canonical prompts. also add a small deterministic eval set to catch tokenization drift.
marta: on failures model should land in `quarantine` state in the catalog with logs + repro commands. automation should tag owner and block deploy.
ops-bot: smoke runner queued: run microbench on model id: m-redwood/xyz-v2 on p4d. estimated finish 2m. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
sanjay: question: what are acceptable perf tradeoffs? e.g. if quantization saves 30% cost but adds 5% tail latency, do we accept? need policy.
liam: proposal: define a small policy DSL: allow latency slack if cost_saving >= 20% AND quality_delta <= 0.5% on eval set. otherwise fail gate. keep defaults strict for public-hosted models.
emma: we should also measure KV cache memory and per-token throughput when cache hit ratio is high. some models have bad scaling with long context, we must catch that.
claire: add schema assertions to onboarding: expected inputs/outputs, optional metadata fields: `vocab_hash`, `model_shasum`, `quant_profile`, `supported_ops`. simple JSON example in PR.
marta: plan for rollout: run new gates on nightly onboarding run for 48h, collect false positive rate, then flip to block on green.
sanjay: action items: 1) liam to draft compatibility matrix template 2) emma to add microbench runner and KV tests 3) claire to write tokenizer+schema tests 4) marta to add quarantine integration with catalog. i'll open the umbrella ticket and PRs.
liam: ack. i'll start the matrix.
emma: ack — will add seq-len harness.
claire: i'll draft schema and small eval set.
marta: i'll wire the quarantine state and notifications.
ops-bot: nightly onboarding job scheduled at 03:00 UTC.
sanjay: thanks all — syncing notes into RFC follow-up doc and linking tickets. ping here if you hit blockers. :eyes:
